processing.loopMethod: 8second complementary sin-squared tail-to-head overlap; circular rotation only
processing.seamMethod: Select existing adjacent stereo PCM16 vectors with exactly equal values; no sample rewrite or silence
processing.normalization: One constant linear gain on the entire48second loop

sourceLicense: CC0 verified on original creator Freesound page
validation: True stereo source; stereo PCM16 44100Hz output
Zero PCM16 stereo endpoint difference without zeroing/fading to silence
One constant gain; no compressor or limiter
inspectionScope: Creator source description/license, full-track spectral and local transient analysis. These checks do not establish human headphone/speaker approval or exclude every background field sound.
levelNote: Natural transient crest retained: RMS is below the aspirational.05–.07 target; raising to that level would violate.28 peak without materially compressing the recording.
